title: Kind manifest
description: What registry.json's kinds[].manifest_url points at: a JSON Schema 2020-12 for the envelope's spec, plus x-registry-* keywords that say which spec paths feed search, which edges are legal, which files a version carries, and whether the kind is gated or attachment-only. This schema constrains the manifest's shape; it does not re-implement the JSON Schema meta-schema, so validate a manifest against both. The file spec leaves the manifest format open; this is the format this repository uses.

$id.description: Identifier for this manifest. A relative reference is permitted; see spec/schemas/README.md.

additionalProperties.description: Each kind chooses whether to allow additional spec fields. Native formats may preserve tool-specific extensions.

x-registry-schema-version.description: Revision marker for this draft manifest. The CLI does not negotiate revisions or enforce compatibility between revisions. Changes to validation rules must document their compatibility impact.

x-registry-searchable.description: JSON Pointers into spec whose text feeds full-text search.

x-registry-embeddings.description: JSON Pointers into spec whose text feeds vector search.

x-registry-edges.description: Legal outbound relationships from this kind.

direction.description: Envelopes store outbound edges only; inbound is derived by a server.

x-registry-files.description: Which files a version of this kind carries.

optional.description: Non-exhaustive conventions for supporting files. Files outside these patterns are permitted.

one_of.description: Exactly one of these file sets MUST be present in full.

x-registry-attachment.description: True when a version of this kind only ever attaches to another kind's version and has no standalone meaning.

x-registry-gated.description: True when a new version is born pending_review and needs a governance action to become active. Which action decides is server configuration.

glob.description: A glob over relative paths; ** matches across directories.
